BREAKING: Elon Musk’s Starlink could dominate the global mobile and internet industry within three years, predicts Morris Group CEO Joseph Grinkorn.

THE PREDICTION

• Investment expert Joseph Grinkorn believes Starlink could change how billions of people access the internet and mobile services.

• He sees the next three years as a major opportunity for Musk to challenge traditional telecom companies.

WHY HE BELIEVES STARLINK COULD LEAD

• Global reach: Satellite internet can connect remote communities where reliable broadband is difficult to get.

• Direct to phone: Satellite connections through partner mobile networks can extend coverage beyond traditional cell towers.

• A huge customer base: The opportunity includes homes, businesses, governments, airlines, ships and remote industries.

• Stronger competition: As satellite services improve, traditional providers could face growing pressure to offer better connectivity.

• Musk’s track record: Grinkorn points to Tesla and SpaceX as reasons to take Starlink’s potential seriously.

THE NETWORK IS ALREADY HUGE

• Starlink reports more than 12 million people using its service across over 160 countries, territories and markets.

• SpaceX reported more than 11,000 Starlink satellites in orbit in October. That gives Musk an enormous network to keep building on. 

THE BIG PUSH INTO MOBILE

• Starlink has already launched more than 650 Direct to Cell satellites, bringing satellite connectivity to ordinary compatible mobile phones.

• SpaceX agreed to buy wireless frequencies from EchoStar in a deal originally worth $17 billion and later expanded to roughly $20 billion. These frequencies will support its next generation of satellite mobile services.

• The partnership also provides for EchoStar’s Boost Mobile customers to access Starlink’s next-generation Direct to Cell service.

WHAT TO WATCH NEXT

• Growth in customers.
• More partnerships with mobile carriers.
• More satellite launches and improved capacity.

Grinkorn believes these developments could make Starlink one of Musk’s biggest achievements.
